description: Lists the workspace's alarms with their conditions, delivery settings and resource addresses. If nextAfterAlarmId is returned, pass it as after_alarm_id to continue. Owners and admins only.

after_alarm_id.description: The alarm id from create_alarm or list_alarms.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

title: List workspace alarms
